blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, CEBU — Always exercise caution when dealing with individuals, who reach out through social media platforms and offer modeling opportunities or product endorsements, particularly when they ask for sample photos. According to Dr. Winley dela Fuente, convenor of CyberShield Against Sexual Exploitation (CASE), at least 13 individuals, mostly Cebu-based models, have sought their help after being subjected to online sexual exploitation, with their photos distributed online without their consent. Dela Fuente said that, in coordination with concerned government agencies, at least two of the alleged perpetrators, who were traced to former POGO IT employees based in Manila, have already […]...
